$comment: The Swiss Clean palette, stated once.
Two files paint a generated application and they cannot share a stylesheet:
the React front end's globals.css declares Tailwind/shadcn variables as HSL
triples, and the browser runtime's styles.css declares plain CSS variables
as hex, because it has no Tailwind. Before this file they each carried their
own copy of every colour, and the note in CLAUDE.md saying 'when that palette
changes, this has to change with it' was the only thing holding them
This is now what both are checked against, by
not generated from — regenerating a stylesheet from JSON would mean a build
step between editing a colour and seeing it — but a drift fails a test rather
than shipping two applications that look like different products.
